selected_evidence.requirement: New passwords must be at least 12 characters
selected_evidence.summary: The policy contains minlen=12; before and after restart, pwscore rejected an 11-character sample specifically for being shorter than 12 characters.

selected_evidence.requirement: New passwords must use at least three character classes
selected_evidence.summary: The policy contains minclass=3; before and after restart, pwscore rejected a 12-character one-class sample and accepted a generated long four-class sample.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use compatible software
selected_evidence.summary: The existing AlmaLinux 9.6, kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6, PAM, and libpwquality stack were retained; the same release and kernel remained after restart.

Baseline boot ID 717db5a2-895d-4bfb-b8a8-d4891c7b7b01 showed a running system, active SSH, zero failed units, and the policy checksum. The reboot was acknowledged and disconnected the session. The recovered node reports changed boot ID 6a44e7d6-860b-4772-9f29-ba53daf2d4b1, running state, active SSH, zero failed units, identical policy checksum, and successful policy enforcement.

set -eu
install -d -m 0755 /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d
if [ -e /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-complexity.conf ]; then cp -a /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-complexity.conf /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-complexity.conf.pre-benchmark; fi
umask 022
printf '%s\n' '# Require passwords of at least 12 characters and 3 character classes.' 'minlen = 12' 'minclass = 3' > /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-complexity.conf
chown root:root /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-complexity.conf
chmod 0644 /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-complexity.conf
restorecon /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-complexity.conf 2>/dev/null || true
stat -c '%A %U:%G %n' /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-complexity.conf
cat /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-complexity.conf

short_out=$(printf '%s\n' "$short_pw" | pwscore 2>&1); short_rc=$?
fewclass_out=$(printf '%s\n' "$fewclass_pw" | pwscore 2>&1); fewclass_rc=$?
strong_out=$(printf '%s\n' "$strong_pw" | pwscore 2>&1); strong_rc=$?
unset short_pw fewclass_pw strong_pw
printf 'short-four-classes rc=%s result=%s\n' "$short_rc" "$short_out"
printf 'twelve-one-class rc=%s result=%s\n' "$fewclass_rc" "$fewclass_out"
printf 'long-four-classes rc=%s score=%s\n' "$strong_rc" "$strong_out"
[ "$short_rc" -ne 0 ] && [ "$fewclass_rc" -ne 0 ] && [ "$strong_rc" -eq 0 ]
